title: From DevOps to Platform Engineering: Kubernetes, Terraform, and Internal Developer Portals
description: How modern infrastructure engineering has shifted to Platform Engineering: Internal Developer Portals, GitOps, Kubernetes operators, and Infrastructure as Code.

image.alt: Platform Engineering Architecture with Kubernetes and GitOps

body:
The traditional DevOps model — where developers submit infrastructure requests or manage ad-hoc cloud resources — created cognitive overload and compliance bottlenecks. In 2026, engineering organizations are building Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) that enable self-service workflows with automated guardrails.

## 1. What is Platform Engineering?

Platform engineering treats infrastructure as a product, providing internal engineering teams with reusable, golden-path templates for provisioning databases, microservices, and networking without manual sysadmin tickets.
- Internal Developer Portals: Backstage and Port providing unified service catalogs, dependency tracking, and one-click environment provisioning.
- Declarative Control Planes: Crossplane turning Kubernetes into a universal control plane that provisions cloud resources (AWS RDS, S3, IAM) via Kubernetes CRDs.

## 2. Modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and OpenTofu

High-performing platform teams manage cloud environments reproducibly:
- Reusable Module Architecture: Standardized VPC, EKS/GKE cluster, and database blueprints with baked-in security policies.
- Policy-as-Code: Open Policy Agent (OPA) and Trivy scanning pull requests to prevent public S3 buckets, permissive security groups, or unencrypted storage before deployment.
- State Locking & Remote Backends: Safe team collaboration with S3/DynamoDB state locks and automated drift detection.

## 3. GitOps and Continuous Deployment with ArgoCD

Push-based deployments have been replaced by pull-based GitOps reconciliation loops:
- Single Source of Truth: All Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts version-controlled in Git repositories.
- ArgoCD / Flux: In-cluster controllers continuously reconciling desired Git state against the active cluster, auto-healing unauthorized manual changes.
- Progressive Delivery: Flagger and Argo Rollouts managing automated Canary and Blue/Green traffic routing based on Prometheus error rates.

## 4. Observability and Site Reliability Engineering

Production systems require unified telemetry across logs, metrics, and distributed traces:
- OpenTelemetry (OTel): Vendor-neutral instrumentation standard across all backend services.
- Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki: Real-time alerting on Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets.

faq.q: Should a beginner learn Docker and Kubernetes before Terraform?
faq.a: Yes. Mastering Linux fundamentals, Docker containerization, and basic networking concepts provides the essential foundation needed before understanding Kubernetes clustering and Terraform infrastructure automation.

faq.q: What certifications are most valuable for DevOps in 2026?
faq.a: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate / DevOps Professional, and HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate are the most recognized industry credentials.
